'''Moraine Outpost''' was a military installation of the [[Balmorran resistance]] located in the [[Moraine Gulch]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Among the personnel stationed there were [[Chedd]], [[Daven Tam]], [[Sheed]] and [[E5-D5]].
